card.name: The word increase in effect statements
card.fires_on: The word "increase" (or increases) right after "an", "significant", "marked" or "did not", describing a rise in drug levels, mutations or malformations. Also weakly on nearby words like "in" and "benefit" in the same kind of phrase.

modes.label: Rise in drug exposure
modes.description: "increase" after an interaction phrase, followed by "in" and a drug concentration or exposure.

modes.label: No significant increase
modes.description: "increase" or "increases" after a negation or "significant" in animal or lab study results.
modes.example: did not cause significant<< increases>> in resorptions or major malform

modes.label: Other benefit or saving wording
modes.description: Related words such as "benefit" or "saving" in risk-benefit phrasing.
modes.example: The potential<< benefit>> of this drug, if used during pregnancy
